description: Chemical ingredient list disclosed for one well, by API number (the American Petroleum Institute well identifier, e.g. "42-317-37262-00-00" or "4231737262" -- dashes optional). Returns, per disclosed job on that well: trade name, supplier, purpose (e.g. "Surfactant", "Biocide", "Proppant"), CAS number, ingredient name, percent of the hydraulic fracturing job by mass, and mass in pounds; trade-secret ingredients carry no CAS number and the claimant company instead. Ingredient-level detail is only loaded for jobs on or after this pack's coverage cutoff (see data_as_of/ingredients_since in the response) -- a well found in frac_wells but outside that window returns found:false with reason "outside_ingredients_coverage", distinct from reason "unknown_api_number" when the well itself does not exist in FracFocus at all.

api_number.description: API well number, with or without dashes, e.g. "42-317-37262-00-00" or "4231737262".
